The '''Copperline system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Vatha sector/Legends|Vatha sector]] within the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Copperline]].
